newsitem.title: USA: Silverado says Ryan Lode shows promise.
newsitem.headline: Silverado says Ryan Lode shows promise.

text.p: Silverado Gold Mines Ltd said drilling at its Ryan Lode Gold Project near Fairbanks has shown impressive quantities of high-, moderate-, and low-grade gold mineralization.
In a statement issued late on Thursday, the company said its geologists expect that, as the drilling program continues, the 822,000-ounce proven gold reserve will expand.

Favorable geologic structures extend from Ryan Lode in both directions, and the deposit is geologically unbounded at depth. The company said there is "significant potential" to continue development at Ryan Lode.
